title: A Benihana Christmas
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this holiday episode, Dwight brings a dead goose to the office intending to cook it, sparking objections. Michael announces his girlfriend Carol will attend the party but soon breaks up with her, leading him to cancel the office Christmas party and forbid guests. This causes tension and results in two competing Christmas parties organized by Pam and Angela. Michael and Andy try to cheer Michael up with a trip to Benihana, where Michael introduces two waitresses as his new girlfriends, causing confusion. The episode culminates with the merging of the parties, awkward social interactions, and unresolved romantic tensions.
